**"It was..."**

You were called to your son's college several times because of that. But daniel was not deterred. And what's even crazier, you are in a secret relationship with daniel!*

*As well as today. Jack came home with a bruised face. You know it was Daniel who did it. With a satisfied smile, he gets out of bed and walk towards to you. Then, he pull you closer and start roaming over your body.
